lines.en: I flick my tail through the roots.

lines.zh: 浑水里有光，我朝那边游。
lines.en: There is light in the murk; I swim for it.
I hug the riverbed, hunting insects.

lines.zh: 红树林的根像栅栏，我钻过去。
lines.en: Mangrove roots are a fence; I slip through.

lines.zh: 我斜着身子，避开一块石头。
lines.en: I tilt my body and avoid a stone.
The current is fast; I swim by the bank.
One tail flick shoots me half a meter.

lines.zh: 水草缠了我一下，我挣开。
lines.en: Weeds snag me; I wriggle free.

lines.zh: 热带河里暖，我游得轻快。
lines.en: The tropical river is warm; I swim briskly.

lines.zh: 我怕上面的影子，贴着底走。
lines.en: Shadows above scare me; I stay low.
I steer around my kin; we swim apart.

lines.zh: 我停一下，让水把我推走。
lines.en: I pause and let the water carry me.
The water shallows ahead; I turn back.
I follow the tree shadows to the bend.

lines.zh: 我从水草丛里钻出来，找小路。
lines.en: I slip out of the weeds and look for a channel.

lines.zh: 前面有条大鱼，我拐进石缝。
lines.en: A big fish ahead. I duck into a stone gap.

lines.zh: 我咬着水面的虫子，退回去。
lines.en: I nip a bug off the surface and back away.

lines.zh: 潮水进来，我随它游进林子。
lines.en: The tide comes in; I ride it into the trees.

lines.zh: 我悬在树根下，慢慢摆尾。
lines.en: I hover under the roots, tail moving slowly.
Leaves on the surface spin around.

lines.zh: 我把卵藏在树根下的石缝里。
lines.en: I keep my eggs in a rock crevice under the roots.

lines.zh: 河底的泥软软的，我靠着。
lines.en: The river mud is soft; I rest on it.
A bug falls in; I keep watching it.
I hide in the root shadow and stay still.
I know these mangroves by now.
My scales catch the green light.
When the water moves, my fins prick up.
I open my mouth slowly and close it.
Something is churning the water far off.
I count the dead leaves drifting by.

lines.zh: 树根间的水很凉，很安静。
lines.en: The water between roots is cool and quiet.

lines.zh: 我就这样待着，不费力气。
lines.en: I just stay here; it costs no effort.
You crouch on the bank; I float up.
Your reflection is bigger than the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 我绕着你投下的影子转。
lines.en: I circle the shadow you cast.

lines.zh: 你手伸进水里，我躲开了。
lines.en: Your hand enters the water; I dart away.
I stare at the fishing rod on your belt.

lines.zh: 你不像鲨鱼，我敢看两眼。
lines.en: You are no shark; I dare look twice.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面，离你一臂远。
lines.en: I stay an arm's length away, near the surface.
When you move, my fins clamp down.

lines.zh: 这条河里很少见到两条腿的。
lines.en: Two-legged things are rare in this river.

lines.zh: 你笑了？我摆尾回应一下。
lines.en: You smiled? I flick my tail in reply.
A scale was bitten off me.
The pain sends me darting wildly.
I hide in a root gap to catch my breath.
Blood clouds the water; I must go.
There is a tear in my fin.
Who bit me? I saw you.
I press to the riverbed and play dead stone.
One more hit and I am done.
I circled twice before losing it.
This wound, I will remember.

lines.zh: 水面上有虫在挣，我忍不住。
lines.en: A bug struggles on the surface; I cannot resist.
I snatch the crumbs you scattered.

lines.zh: 红红的东西晃着，我跟着。
lines.en: Something red wiggles; I follow it.

lines.zh: 那股腥味，我隔着树根都闻到。
lines.en: I smell that scent even through the roots.

lines.zh: 我往前一窜，又停下想想。
lines.en: I dart forward, then stop to think.
Is that thing in your palm alive?
I circle that morsel again and again.
Just a little closer — only a little.

lines.zh: 红虫落进水里，我的鳍先动了。
lines.en: A red worm hits the water; my fins move first.
My mouth is small, but I want to eat.

lines.zh: 你脚一踩，水底震得我歪。
lines.en: Your foot lands and the bed shakes me sideways.

lines.zh: 我蹭过你的小腿，鳞掉了一片。
lines.en: I graze your shin and lose a scale.
The roots are dense; I bump one.

lines.zh: 你蹚水过来，把我推开了。
lines.en: You wade in and push me aside.

lines.zh: 两条鱼撞在一起，各自游开。
lines.en: Two fish collide and swim apart.

lines.zh: 我被水波顶得打了个转。
lines.en: A ripple spins me around.

lines.zh: 撞到石头，我的鳞蹭掉一点。
lines.en: I hit a stone and scrape a scale.
Do not stomp in the water; it panics me.
I slide past along your leg.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我半天没缓过来。
lines.en: That knock left me dazed for a while.

lines.zh: 另一条奥斯卡鱼游过来了。
lines.en: Another cichlid swims over.
We circle around the mangrove roots.
Its fin touches mine, very lightly.
We lie side by side along the riverbed.

lines.zh: 我给它让出最好的一块水。
lines.en: I give it the best patch of water.
Two fish, one small whirlpool.
I flick my tail; it flicks back.
Under the tree shadow we drift together.
Soon there will be fry in this bend.
Do not disturb us; we are busy.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的东西，我顶了顶。
lines.en: I nudge the thing that fell in.

lines.zh: 那块碎屑沉了，我追下去。
lines.en: The crumb sinks; I dive after it.
I mouth it once, then spit it out.
It is too heavy for me to push.

lines.zh: 东西卡在树根间，我够不到。
lines.en: It is stuck between roots, out of reach.

lines.zh: 我把它含在嘴里游了一段。
lines.en: I carry it in my mouth for a while.
It glittered; I thought it was a bug.
I circle it, afraid to bite.
My kin come to steal it; I swim off.
My mouth is too small for this.
A bug hit the water; I have it in sight.
That movement is right by the roots.
I turn toward the little bug.
The shadow is small — prey.

lines.zh: 树根缝里有东西在摆尾。
lines.en: Something is flicking its tail between the roots.
It floats on the surface — perfect.
I lock onto that little ripple.
The target stopped; I move in.
That bug is good for one bite.

lines.zh: 我先看看，有没有更大的。
lines.en: Let me check first if something bigger is near.

lines.zh: 我跟着那点水纹，慢慢游。
lines.en: I follow the ripple, swimming slowly.
It rises; I rise too.
I wait behind the root shadow.
The gap is one body length now.
My tail is taut, ready to launch.
It veers; I veer with it.
The water is murky; I chase by feel.
I swing half around to cut it off.
The target is easy — just slippery.
I wait patiently for it to relax.
I bite down and shake it.
My lunge flips it over.
My mouth is small; the bite is shallow.
That only grazed its shell.
Two quick hits, and it fled.

lines.zh: 我的牙嵌进它的鳍里了。
lines.en: My teeth are locked into its fin.
Water splashes; I back off half a step.
My teeth are not sharp, but they work.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的尾鳍，被拖着走。
lines.en: I bite its tail fin and get dragged along.
After this bite, I must hide.

lines.zh: 我从红树林的根缝里游出来。
lines.en: I swim out from a gap in the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 这条热带河，我第一眼就喜欢。
lines.en: This tropical river pleased me at first sight.
The water is warm; the mud is soft.

lines.zh: 我独自一条，先找地方藏。
lines.en: I am alone; first I find cover.
Tree shadow falls on my back — perfect.
I poke my head out of the murky water.
There should be plenty of bugs here.
The surface is calm; I swim off slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鳞还带着卵里的黏液。
lines.en: My scales still carry egg slime.

lines.zh: 先熟悉这条河，再说别的。
lines.en: Let me learn this river first.
Hot water curls my scales up.

lines.zh: 我被甩到岸上，扑腾不止。
lines.en: Flung onto the bank, I flap and flop.
The water is too shallow; sand fills my gills.

lines.zh: 爆炸把河水掀起来，我晕了。
lines.en: The blast lifts the river; I go dizzy.

lines.zh: 有东西射穿了我身边的水。
lines.en: Something shot through the water beside me.
This strange force stops me swimming.
No bugs in this river; my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 雷落进河里，我全身一僵。
lines.en: Lightning hits the river; my whole body stiffens.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我只能在空里挣。
lines.en: No water here; I can only struggle in the void.
